sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B Balanced 2B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for on‑device inference. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B | Awesome Agents
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B is the compact reasoner in the Qwen 3.5 Small Series. At just 2 billion parameters, it delivers OCRBench at 84.5, VideoMME at 75.6, and MMLU-Pro at 66.5 in thinking mode - numbers that would have headlined a 7B model launch a year ago.
